name: Kemonomimi Kenshi Yumiru Kairaku Choukyou ~Lez Succubus no Seidorei ni Sareta Watashi~
original_name: 獣耳剣士ユミル快楽調教 〜レズサキュバスの性奴隷にされた私〜
source:
The beast-eared girl Ymir enters a dungeon in search of treasure.
